newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Avimo to buy two U.K. optic firms.
newsitem.headline: Avimo to buy two U.K. optic firms.

text.p: The Avimo Group Ltd said on Thursday its unit, Avimo Europe Ltd, would buy two companies of OMI International Plc for about Singapore $19.4 million.
It said in a statement the purchase of Omitec Electro-Optics and Omitec Thin Films Ltd was part of its strategy to expand into the growing market for high quality commercial optics.
The markets for laser scanning lenses and high specification imaging optics are expected to show significant growth, it said.
Avimo will finance the purchase through cash resources and partly through bank borrowings in Britain.
The acquisitions were not expected to have a material effect on the earnings per share of the Avimo Group for the financial year ending September 30, 1997, the statement said.
